The drums layer (the stem Demucs separates from this very recording) stands 18.5 dB under the mix in 300 Hz-4 kHz (replaced: 2.3 dB, level with the mix), 13.4 dB under in its loudest 250 ms (replaced: 1.1 dB under) and in 5 % of the 250 ms windows within 6 dB of the mix (replaced: 22 %); over the whole band the stem is 6.1 dB under the recording (MusicBake: -21.1 against -15.0 dBFS), the deep soft bass notes that Demucs puts in it. Its crest (the stem's loud 250 ms over its median) reads 43 dB, as the replaced recording's 38 dB did: the stem is near silence between its phrases, so the figure says sparse, not loud. No trim: the bake's gain is -1.9 dB, the post-codec peak -1.18 dBFS, 0 clipped runs. Judged by numbers only: whether the tune is pleasant and the drums are now unobtrusive enough are for the owner's ear.
